author: ojiudezue
title: Guest stay exit day veto (>=10% guest-room day share holds the stay); house master tick stays parked
summary: Simpler onset thresholds (day >10% / night >30-40% arm-confirm) were measured and none was faster, so entry stays 0.25 night / 0.10 day / 2 nights. Added only an exit veto: empty nights do not end a stay while any guest room's 10:00-to-bedtime non-resident share was >=0.10 on a day paired with a night in the exit window. Guest left press still beats it. The master house timer loop was evaluated and parked (URA-CENTRAL-TICK-WHEEL-1).
why: The October replay showed the stay dropping on days guests were plainly present (out all night, in the room by day); the veto recovers 19/21 days with 0 false days in the clean period. The tick wheel offered no consumer whose latency or synchrony problem it solves today, and adds a shared timing primitive.
implications: Re-entry grace reaches hold length + 7 days; a phantom daytime hold in GB1/GB2 (no fan-immune witness, GB2 no BLE) can hold GUEST up to the 35-night window, with the 28-day page as notify-only backstop. Veto holder is published on the house-state sensor (guest_stay_day_veto_*). Kill switch: GUEST_STAY_EXIT_DAY_VETO_FRACTION > 1.
revisit_trigger: A guest stay held by the veto with no guest present (phantom), or a resident's daytime GB2 use holding GUEST
